feeds.title: Macheesmo
feeds.description: The popular food blog, by Nick Evans, featuring over 1,000 homemade recipes, weekly meal plans, quick and easy weeknight dinners, and step by step directions.

feeds.title: Southern Bite
feeds.description: Father, Cookbook Author, and Southern food blogger sharing tried and true Southern recipes.

feeds.title: DadCooksDinner
feeds.description: I'm Mike Vrobel, a dad who cooks dinner every night. I'm an enthusiastic home cook, and I write about pressure cooking, rotisserie grilling, and other food topics that grab my attention.

feeds.title: Dad With A Pan Blog
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Derek and I am a dad, food blogger, and fixer of broken toys. I love encouraging families to cook by sharing recipes, tips, and tricks that make cooking simple.

feeds.title: Lunchbox Dad
feeds.description: My name is Beau and I want to help you make lunch time fun, connect with your kids, and show you products that make your life as a busy parent easier. Each week on Lunchbox Dad you will find creative recipes, funny pictures, and my thoughts on parenting and life in general.

feeds.title: Real Food by Dad
feeds.description: Real Food by Dad is a dads food blog with hundreds of simple, sometimes healthy, always tasty breakfast, lunch and dinner recipes, plus lots of game day food ideas.

feeds.title: Dads That Cook
feeds.description: All things cooking! Recipes, cooking for men, simple meals, easy 30 minute meals. Dads That Cook, a blog by Jason Glover who finds dads that love to cook and create incredible meals for their families. Fun and Food!

feeds.title: 2 Dads with Baggage » Food-Recipes
feeds.description: 2 Dads with Baggage is an LGBT family blog. We are two dads with two teen girls, sharing our global experience of food, traveling, lifestyle, parenthood and gay travel with kids. Read our blog as we travel, navigate, experience and grow.

feeds.title: The Domestic Man
feeds.description: Hi, my name is Russ Crandall. Here you'll find gluten-free and Paleo-friendly recipes that focus on classic, traditional, and international dishes from a historical, linguistic, and cultural perspective.

feeds.title: World Travel Chef Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I am James, a professional chef and world foodist with a career spanning 20 years and 2 hemispheres. Now I am out of the kitchens, I run this recipe, world food and travel blog as I have traveled the world broadening my culinary expertise and learning new and traditional ways with food.

feeds.title: Vegetarian Dad
feeds.description: My name is Paul and I hope to use this blog to share some of my favorite vegetarian recipes and also my adventures in trying to start up a cafe whilst juggling childcare and being a house-husband!

feeds.title: Foodness Gracious
feeds.description: Hi, I am Gerry Speirs and I am a stay-at-home dad with two kids to feed. It is not always easy but I always love to cook dinner every night for the family, and I want to pass my tips and favorite recipes to you!
